title.fr: Image d'un objet lumineux donnée par une lentille

sketch:
Observe: SVG bench with object AB (upright arrow), convergente of
fixed f', and the three characteristic rays traced from B
(parallel→F', through O straight, through F→parallel) intersecting
at B'. Student drags AB along axis; image A'B' moves, flips through
infinity as AB crosses F. HUD labels réel/virtuel, droit/renversé.
Experiment: 3 seeded object positions with target image positions;
student places AB so A'B' lands on each. Evaluate: construction rays
hidden, only AB and a ghost outline of A'B'-region shown; peek
reveals one ray briefly.
